infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Geda Transfer reads the photos and videos you choose to send to your own computer. It never modifies or deletes anything.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used once, to scan the pairing code your computer shows.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Geda Transfer sends your photos directly to your computer over your own network. Nothing is uploaded to any service.
